title: Model
description: A trained model, or a family of them, that its maker releases under a name: GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, Qwen3.8, Wan 2.7. A product, app, agent, feature, platform or service is not a model, even when it runs on one or shares its brand.
x-description-zh-CN: 厂商以某个名字发布的一个训练好的模型，或一个模型系列：GPT-6 Astra、Claude Fable 5.1、Qwen3.8、Wan 2.7。产品、应用、智能体、功能、平台、服务都不是模型，即使它跑在模型上、或与模型同名。

model_id.description: model:<owner>:<slug of the name>. Stable; never reused.
model_id.x-description-zh-CN: model:<归属方>:<名字的规范写法>。稳定，不复用。

org_id.description: The company that makes the model, when it is one we follow.
org_id.x-description-zh-CN: 出品公司，限我们跟踪的公司。

parent_model_id.description: The family a release belongs to. A family has none.
parent_model_id.x-description-zh-CN: 具体版本所属的系列。系列自身没有。

name.description: The release name as its maker writes it, without a date or build suffix.
name.x-description-zh-CN: 厂商的写法，不带日期或构建号后缀。

version.description: The version as written. Never inferred; a family has none.
version.x-description-zh-CN: 文本里写出的版本号。不推断；系列没有。

variant.description: The variant (Flash, Pro, mini). A family has none.

status.description: How far the model's existence is established.
status.x-description-zh-CN: 模型的存在被确认到什么程度。

released_at.description: When the maker's own release update happened. Set only by confirmation.
released_at.x-description-zh-CN: 厂商自己的发布帖的时间。只在确认时写入。

owner_zh_cn.description: Chinese name of the owning organization.
